name: JEF_Scene
author: Mitake Cyber Security Dev Dept
description: Run a JEF scene over an observable and return the full decision trace: evidence, questions, allowed answers, probabilities, calibrated confidence and which gate fired.

configurationItems.name: url
configurationItems.description: Base URL of the JEF server, e.g. http://jef.internal:8080

configurationItems.name: scene
configurationItems.description: Scene id to run, e.g. incident-triage

configurationItems.name: timeout
configurationItems.description: Request timeout in seconds. A cold CPU encode is not instant.

configurationItems.name: api_key
configurationItems.description: Optional bearer token, if the JEF server sits behind an authenticating proxy
